newsitem.title: USA: First United to acquire Citizens National.
newsitem.headline: First United to acquire Citizens National.

text.p: First United Bancshares said on Wednesday that it intends to acquire Citizens National Bancshares, an Arkansas-based bank, for 1.57 million shares of common stock, valued at $61.6 million.
Under the letter of intent for the merger, First United is expected to account for the deal as a pooling of interests.
Citizens National is the parent company of Citizens National Bank, which has four locations and total assets of $263 million as of March 31, 1997.
First United, which has assets of $1.56 billion, anticipates this transaction will close during the fourth quarter of this year after shareholder and regulatory approvals, it said.
